title: Grateful Dead Live at Uptown Theater on 1978-01-31
lineage: DAT (Sony PCM-M1) > Sony 7-pin/Oade digi I/O > Hosa DRA-501 coax cable > Tascam CD-RW750 > CDR  CDR (Tascam SS-CDR200) > Tascam DA-3000 > .wav(16bit/44.1 kHz) > Adobe Audition 2022 > TLH flac16
source: Master FOB Audience Cassettes (possibly Tim Powell); Sony ECM-99 mics > (most likely) Sony TC-152 > Reel to Reel > Tim McKenzie's DAT 16 bit/44.1 kHz (KAO Gold 460m) > CDR

ai_review.summary: Clear front‑balcony audience recording that captures a solid mid‑west run despite some venue echo.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers praise this audience (AUD) tape as one of the best for the January 31 1978 show, noting its front‑row balcony perspective and overall good sound quality even with the Uptown hall’s natural echo. While no specific songs are highlighted, the recording is recommended as a strong representation of the underrated Midwest series.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are favorable about the tape’s clarity and its place in a good run of shows; limited detail on musical performance keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑row balcony capture with clear instrument balance; venue’s natural echo is noticeable but does not detract significantly from overall listenability.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewers regard the concert as part of a strong Chicago/Madison/Milwaukee run.
